title: Teaching Assistants, Preschool, Elementary, Middle, and Secondary School, Except Special Education
description: Assist a preschool, elementary, middle, or secondary school teacher with instructional duties. Serve in a position for which a teacher has primary responsibility for the design and implementation of educational programs and services.

tasks.text: Supervise students in classrooms, halls, cafeterias, school yards, and gymnasiums, or on field trips.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live supervision of students is inherently human presence

tasks.text: Tutor and assist children individually or in small groups to help them master assignments and to reinforce learning concepts presented by teachers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — AI can tutor content; diagnosing learner needs is human

dwas.name: Tutor students who need extra assistance.

tasks.text: Enforce administration policies and rules governing students.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Enforcing behavior requires in-person authority and judgment

dwas.name: Enforce rules or policies governing student behavior.

tasks.text: Teach social skills to students.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Daily living skills taught in person with feedback

dwas.name: Teach daily living skills or behaviors.

tasks.text: Instruct and monitor students in the use and care of equipment and materials to prevent injuries and damage.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI grades and tracks metrics; human interprets holistically

dwas.name: Teach others to use technology or equipment.

tasks.text: Discuss assigned duties with classroom teachers to coordinate instructional efforts.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Curriculum collaboration is professional consensus work

dwas.name: Collaborate with other teaching professionals to develop educational programs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Present subject matter to students under the direction and guidance of teachers, using lectures, discussions, supervised role-playing methods, or by reading aloud.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Leading live classes/events requires human presence

tasks.text: Clean classrooms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of work areas

tasks.text: Observe students' performance, and record relevant data to assess progress.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured student records in databases

tasks.text: Organize and label materials and display students' work in a manner appropriate for their eye levels and perceptual skills.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Displaying student work is physical placement

tasks.text: Organize and supervise games and other recreational activities to promote physical, mental, and social development.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Drafts activity plans; educator adapts to learners

tasks.text: Attend staff meetings and serve on committees, as required.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Committee service requires presence, negotiation, accountability

dwas.name: Serve on institutional or departmental committees.

tasks.text: Use computers, audio-visual aids, and other equipment and materials to supplement presentations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Generate learning content; human owns pedagogy

tasks.text: Prepare lesson materials, bulletin board displays, exhibits, equipment, and demonstrations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Develop instructional materials; human reviews

tasks.text: Conduct demonstrations to teach skills, such as sports, dancing, and handicrafts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical education requires live physical instruction

tasks.text: Distribute teaching materials, such as textbooks, workbooks, papers, and pencils, to students.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically handing out materials to people

tasks.text: Type, file, and duplicate materials.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Laminate teaching materials to increase their durability under repeated use.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Setting up classroom materials is physical arrangement

dwas.name: Set up classroom materials or equipment.

tasks.text: Requisition and stock teaching materials and supplies.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Take class attendance and maintain attendance records.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured student records in databases

tasks.text: Participate in teacher-parent conferences regarding students' progress or problems.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Progress discussions need relationship and judgment

dwas.name: Discuss student progress with parents or guardians.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Assist in bus loading and unloading.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live supervision of students is inherently human presence

tasks.text: Maintain computers in classrooms and laboratories, and assist students with hardware and software use.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Software side AI-assisted; hardware maintenance is hands-on

tasks.text: Grade homework and tests, and compute and record results, using answer sheets or electronic marking devices.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured student records in databases

dwas.name: Evaluate student work.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Plan, prepare, and develop various teaching aids, such as bibliographies, charts, and graphs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Develop instructional materials; human reviews

tasks.text: Operate and maintain audio-visual equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Audiovisual equipment set up and operated by hand

tasks.text: Distribute tests and homework assignments and collect them when they are completed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically handing out materials to people

tasks.text: Collect money from students for school-related projects.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Handling cash/payment collection in person
